Name: SVE - Expressive Olivia (supports Seasonal Characters)
Author: spphcmttron
Description:
Adds portrait tweaks to SVE Olivia's portraits to be more expressive. She can now open her mouth and clutch her pearls!

Additionally, it has a mod config option that adds subtle expression lines, for those who are into that.

Most recent update has made it possible to add compatibility with other mods which edit/add portraits for Olivia. [b]No images are being re-distributed, [/b]only patched over with my original tweaks.

[b]Requires Content Patcher and Stardew Valley Expanded. [/b]

Installation:
Download zip file. Go into your game directory. Extract the zip into your Mods folder.

Unless listed below, this mod may conflict with other portrait mods that alter Olivia's portraits.
